high_level_description: stc brand style, a professional meeting of four colleagues in traditional Middle Eastern attire seated around a wooden conference table.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern office with wooden wall paneling featuring vertical slats, a wall-mounted lamp with a white shade, a small potted plant, and purple-tinted lighting.

elements.desc: Two men wearing white thobes and red and white checkered shemagh headdresses seated at the table.
A woman wearing a black hijab seated beside a woman wearing a purple headscarf.
A wooden conference table with a reddish-brown top and black office chairs.
